title: Transaction fees
content: Northwind Pay charges 1.5% per card transaction, capped at $5. Bank transfers are free.

title: Daily transfer limits
content: The default daily transfer limit is $10,000. Verified business accounts can request up to $50,000.

title: Support hours
content: Customer support is available Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm Eastern.

title: Refunds
content: Refunds are processed within 5 business days to the original payment method.

title: Account verification
content: Verification requires a government ID and proof of address, and is reviewed within 2 business days.
